issues.description: The paper does not report the number of raw unsupervised clusters for the human or mouse CellRef constructions; cluster inventory records the final annotated cell-type counts (48 human, 40 mouse) and cannot verify whether additional unannotated clusters existed.

All verified markers are outside the L4 PNEC target scope. The paper mentions PNEC as a CellRef cell type but does not provide explicit PNEC marker genes in the Markdown text; no PNEC-specific markers could therefore be added.
